annotations.title: Create an animated video from your own content

description: [40 credits] From content you hold (figures, notes, story), no URL. You write scenes; each drawn, voiced, captioned (list_motions: 25 visuals, some with kinds; visual "rushie" = 664 designed cards, e.g. data {rushie:{template:"end-card",props:{headline,mark,url,cta}}}). AI clips (paid plans) only if asked: data.generate (+data.clip) per scene, or ai_mode rich (assist: stills), the server picks scenes, writes prompts; dry_run shows ai_plan.added. Returns a receipt; get_video for the full status.

ai_budget.description: A ceiling on this render's AI generation; the receipt's ai_plan says what was asked for and its cost. Omitted: uncapped.

on_exceed.description: Over the ceiling. refuse (default): create_animation creates nothing; create_video, planned after the call, keeps to the ceiling. fallback: renders, generating only up to the ceiling. queue: generates all.

ai_mode.description: As create_video. Server picks scenes and prompts; omitted: data.generate only.

aspect_ratio.description: 16:9 for web and YouTube, 9:16 for Reels/Shorts/TikTok, 1:1 and 4:5 (1080×1350) for feeds.

brand_name.description: Name shown on the intro and outro cards.

character.description: With ai_mode: in every added shot.

cta_text.description: Call to action on the closing card.

dry_run.description: Quote only; nothing made or charged.

intro.description: Include the branded opening title card.

language.description: As create_video. Write the narration in it.

objects.description: With ai_mode: in every added shot.

scenes.description: The scenes, in order, 1-20, all validated before anything is charged. On top of the render, a still (data.generate) costs 40 and a clip (data.clip) 311, refunded if it fails.

data.description: The visual's payload; list_motions.visuals[].requires names the fields.

duration_seconds.description: Hold of a scene with no narration.

heading.description: A few words naming the beat.

motion.description: Entrance animation from the visual's family; omitted, one is chosen.

narration.description: Spoken over the scene; its length IS the scene's. [pause 500ms] = silence.

style.description: This scene's own look, overriding the film's theme.

accent2.description: Hex gradient end; omit for flat.

theme.description: Ground; brand paints the accent behind.

from_library.description: A saved scene's name or id (list_scenes), footage and media included — no AI cost.

source_url.description: Attribution only; nothing is fetched or filmed.

target_seconds.description: A check, not a setting: your words set the length. A script over 15% off is refused before any credit moves, with the words to cut or add. Omitted: the scenes alone must run at least 15 s, the film at most 180 s.

theme.description: As create_video. Omitted: the house palette.

title.description: Name for the video. Defaults to the first scene's heading.

name: create_animation

clips_allowed.description: The ceiling ai_budget set for THIS call, not a limit on your plan (without one: the scene count, i.e. nothing capped).

formats.description: Every shape: video_id, aspect_ratio, status, primary, video_url.

models_used.description: Per generated visual: scene, kind, model, reason.

title: Create an animated video from your own content
